message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine statutory charges based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: a credit cooperative loan officer illegally disbursed loans and embezzled funds. Likely crimes: "非法发放贷款罪" (illegal loan issuance) and "挪用资金罪" (misappropriation of funds). Also possibly "职务侵占罪" (misappropriation of public funds by a staff). Under Chinese law, credit cooperative is a financial institution; illegal loan issuance by staff is "非法发放贷款罪" (Article 176 of Criminal Law). Embezzlement of funds could be "挪用资金罪" (Article 382). Also "职务侵占罪" (Article 382 also covers misappropriation of public funds). The facts: he used his position to issue loans to others, some using false identities, and also used relatives' documents to get loan for himself. This is illegal loan issuance and embezzlement. So answer: [罪名]非法发放贷款罪;挪用资金罪<eoa>
